articles.title: NFL trade deadline 2026: Vikings reunite with Kirk Cousins; Colts stick with Taylor; 49ers get WR Allen – live reaction
articles.summary: All the latest news and deals before today’s deadline. Vikings reunite with QB Kirk Cousins in deal with Vegas. Niners add WR Keenan Allen; Bills land S Amani Hooker. Follow the buildup to the 4pm ET cutoff and fallout. Email Bryan with your thoughts on the deadline moves.
body: The NFL trade deadline has come and gone, bringing an end to a busy period of roster reshuffling across the league. Seventeen trades were completed during the season, including Kirk Cousins’ return to Minnesota, Josh Downs’ move to Kansas City and a flurry of activity involving the Jacksonville Jaguars.
Teams can no longer complete trades until the new league year begins at 4pm ET on 11 March 2027, although deals can be agreed in principle before then.

Another important wrinkle: from now until the end of the season, every player whose contract is terminated must pass through waivers, regardless of veteran status. That means even established veterans cannot immediately choose their next destination if released.

Correction: that’s 18 trades after last-minute deal sending Atlanta Falcons center Ryan Neuzil to the Baltimore Ravens in exchange for offensive lineman Andrew Vorhees and a sixth-round pick in the 2028 draft.
points: All the latest news and deals before today’s deadline.
Vikings reunite with QB Kirk Cousins in deal with Vegas.
Niners add WR Keenan Allen; Bills land S Amani Hooker.
Follow the buildup to the 4pm ET cutoff and fallout.
articles.author: Ella Brockway (before) and Bryan Armen Graham (now)

articles.title: Kirk Cousins returns to Vikings as Raiders hand starting job to Fernando Mendoza
articles.summary: Minnesota acquire veteran quarterback for 2027 pick. Cousins returns to Vikings after six seasons with team. No 1 pick Mendoza set to make first NFL start. Kirk Cousins is heading back to Minnesota.
body: The Vikings have acquired the veteran quarterback from the Las Vegas Raiders in exchange for a third-round pick in the 2027 draft, according to multiple reports, including from ESPN’s Adam Schefter and NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport.

The move reunites Cousins with the franchise where he spent six seasons from 2018 to 2023 and gives Minnesota an experienced option under center as they look to revive their season. The Vikings had leapt out to a 6-0 start to the season thanks to their standout defense, but the team have lost their last two games. Former No 1 overall pick Kyler Murray had been their starter, but he has been underwhelming in his first season in Minnesota. He missed Monday’s loss to the Buffalo Bills through injury and his replacement, Carson Wentz, threw two interceptions and was lucky to avoid another in a dreadful performance.
After Monday’s loss, Minnesota head coach Kevin O’Connell admitted the team was looking at other options.

No 1 pick Mendoza set to make first NFL start.

articles.title: Pocognoli to lean on Scotland's 'captain group of five'
articles.summary: Sebastien Pocognoli is delighted to welcome "exciting" Scott McTominay into his squad, saying the Napoli midfielder is one of the "fantastic leaders" that helped persuade him to become Scotland head coach.
body: The Belgian revealed the fit-again 29-year-old "is in my captain group of five", who will be relied upon to make sure his instructions are carried out on the field of play.

McTominay missed Pocognoli's first, four-game Uefa Nations League camp in charge as Scotland drew with Slovenia, lost to Switzerland, beat North Macedonia, but then lost the return at home to the Slovenians.
The midfielder, who is back playing after a minor heart procedure, has revealed he received treatment to correct an irregular heartbeat two days before Scotland's World Cup win over Haiti in June.
"I don't have to paint a picture of how important a player he is for us," said Pocognoli as he prepared for Friday's meeting with North Macedonia at Hampden.

articles.title: McTominay reveals heart treatment two days before Scotland’s World Cup opener
articles.summary: Midfielder was in hospital before Haiti match. ‘I had to get the shock on my heart,’ says McTominay. Scott McTominay has revealed he was in hospital under sedation to have a “shock on my heart” just 48 hours before Scotland began their World Cup campaign against Haiti in June.
body: At the time McTominay’s absence from training was put down to a stomach complaint. It emerged in August that the Napoli midfielder needed surgery to remedy an irregular heartbeat. The operation took place in September, causing McTominay to miss Scotland’s first four Nations League matches. The player has now said the matter arose in the US as Scotland prepared for their World Cup opener at Boston Stadium.

McTominay is back in the international fold for Scotland’s fixtures against North Macedonia and Switzerland. Talking to media in Glasgow the 29-year-old said: “The World Cup was difficult for me to be honest. I had to go and get the shock on my heart. It was two days before the Haiti game and you have prepared so well. I was in such good condition and then something like that happens. And you think: ‘How is this happening to me?’ But then you have to get on with it.

“These are cards you are dealt in football. Sometimes things don’t go your way and you have to continue to do your best. It’s nowhere near an excuse but it’s something you have to look back on and say it’s part of the process.

articles.title: Rio Ngumoha ready to make England splash as he spells out Ballon d’Or ambition
articles.summary: Fearless winger has forced his way into Thomas Tuchel’s plans and believes he can become best player in the world. Rio Ngumoha is fearless, exciting and ready to make his mark as an England player.
body: There is an opportunity for the 18-year-old to advance his case with Bukayo Saka injured and more experienced players left out for the Nations League games against Croatia and Spain this week. Ngumoha, who is dangerous on both flanks, has a chance of starting when Croatia visit Wembley on Thursday and would love to test himself against Lamine Yamal when England face Spain in Madrid on Sunday.

“What he’s doing changed football for young players,” Ngumoha says of Barcelona’s 19-year-old winger. “He’s phenomenal. He’s one of the best in the world. Seeing what he can do so young inspires me and all the other young players in how we can just play freely. The way he plays, it’s like it’s his pitch. It’s a good challenge.”

Ngumoha has rarely been afraid to test himself. One of the few times he has shown trepidation was when he was a small boy, impressing at grassroots level, and was asked to play with an older age group. “I was six, maybe five, playing for a local team,” he says. “I got an assist and I could hear my mum on the side saying well done. Then they started saying that I was playing with the older players and I just panicked and started crying.

Rio Ngumoha is fearless, exciting and ready to make his mark as an England player.

articles.title: Vikings reportedly re-sign Cousins from Raiders
articles.summary: The Minnesota Vikings have reportedly re-signed quarterback Kirk Cousins in a trade with the Las Vegas Raiders in order to improve their offence.
body: Cousins spent six years with the Vikings from 2018-2023 before he left to join the Atlanta Falcons as a free agent in 2024.
The Vikings have since struggled to find a replacement for him and have eight quarterbacks start since his move.
It means that the 2026 No 1 pick Carlos Mendoza will now be the starting quarterback for the Raiders and the Las Vegas outfit have also received a 2027 third-round pick for the trade.
The Vikings had an extra third-round selection from Philadelphia in a swap they made in April for edge rusher Jonathan Greenard.

articles.title: Partick Thistle lose SWPL points for amateur player payments
articles.summary: Partick Thistle are deducted three points and fined £6,000 by the Scottish Women's Premier League for making payments to players who were registered as amateurs last season.
body: Thistle finished sixth last season and the points penalty means they slip one place to second bottom spot, three points behind Spartans, in the current 10-team table.

It follows a hearing on Monday at which the Glasgow club were found to be in breach of rules about making payments to amateur registered players and "submitting incorrect information regarding the submission of the certificate and undertaking document required as part of the membership criteria process".
Thistle had the right of appeal but said on their website that the club "acknowledges and accepts the verdict".

They add: "The circumstances which led to the breach of SWPL player rule 37 and competition rule E31.11 were a result of a failure of internal process, which has since been addressed and resolved so that it can not occur in future.

articles.title: Hill insists Ferrari should back 'extraordinary' Hamilton over Leclerc
articles.summary: Former Formula 1 world champion Damon Hill has insisted Ferrari should back the "extraordinary" Lewis Hamilton over his team-mate Charles Leclerc if they want to have a chance of winning next year's drivers' title.
body: Ferrari's handling of their drivers came under increased scrutiny earlier this month following the Mexico City Grand Prix when a first-lap clash between Hamilton and Leclerc, running in first and second respectively at the time, cost the Italian team a likely one-two, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen going on to win the race.

Hamilton, who had started on pole and led on the approach to the first corner, was highly critical of Leclerc after the race for what he perceived to be an overly aggressive approach against a team-mate. Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur also expressed his displeasure at the incident.
The seven-time world champion said any issues he had with Leclerc had been "squashed" following a conversation at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, which came the weekend after the race in Mexico.

Hill, the 1996 world champion, wrote on social media following the race in Mexico that Italian squad should make Hamilton their number one driver for the 2027 season and that "Lewis will deliver for Ferrari if they back him 100 per cent."

articles.title: Sky pledges backing for Equal Sport Project
articles.summary: Sky Sports is proud to support Equal Sport Project, which aims to accelerate progress towards equality across sport through five shared ambitions.
body: The Equal Sport Project unites sport in the UK behind five shared ambitions for women and men across sport - from local leisure centres to the biggest stadiums, and from grassroots pitches to boardrooms.

Major sporting organisations from across the UK's sporting landscape - including the FA, RFU, Youth Sport Trust, England Netball, UK Sport, LTA, Women's Sport Trust, Women in Sport, Team GB and Sport England - have made specific pledges to drive progress and help turn these ambitions into reality. Brands and broadcasters are also playing their part, signalling growing support for the movement across the wider sporting industry.
The rest of the industry is also being asked to commit support and pledges as the project seeks to gain momentum in the months and years to come.
The project launch comes at a time when the momentum of women's sport has never been stronger; participation is growing, audiences are growing and investment is accelerating.

articles.title: Video catches USC announcer's take on targeting call
articles.summary: He said what? That’s what many were asking regarding longtime USC football radio play-by-play announcer Pete Arbogast’s reaction to Oregon quarterback Dante Moore being knocked out of Saturday’s 41-27 Ducks’ victory at Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum.
body: The play occurred in the second quarter when Moore scrambled and slid. USC linebacker Desman Stephens II then put his shoulder into Moore’s head, knocking him backward into the turf.
Moore lay on the field for several minutes before being taken off on a cart and loaded into an ambulance.
Stephens celebrated the hit even after being flagged, leading to a skirmish with several Oregon players.
Meanwhile, up in the radio booth, Arbogast said the play did not appear to be targeting and claimed Moore didn’t slide feet-first.

articles.title: Reynolds: Fearless Love can lead Packers to Super Bowl
articles.summary: I'm well aware that we've only reached the halfway point of the 2026 season and so much can change in the NFL, especially at the back end of the year.
body: But I'm now starting to believe the Green Bay Packers can make a serious run and they have emerged as true contenders in the NFC.
Sunday's 45-27 win over the New England Patriots in Foxborough was a statement victory and it was a win that showed the Packers to be a complete team.

Jordan Love is playing as well as any quarterback in the NFL this season and he backed it up on Sunday on a big stage in a game being called by Tom Brady as he threw for 372 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions.
He could not look more comfortable right now. He's in his bag, he's playing with confidence, he's playing calmly and it looks like he has no fear.

articles.title: John Gibson Gets the Net Back Despite Tarasov’s Numbers
articles.summary: John Gibson is back in the Detroit Red Wings net on Tuesday night in St. Louis, and the numbers say Daniil Tarasov should be. Gibson is carrying a.860 save percentage and a 3.46 goals-against average through 11 games. Tarasov sits at.919 and 2.10 through eight.
body: Gibson left the Nov. 3 game at the Tampa Bay Lightning after the first period with a lower-body injury and missed the next two games, a 4-2 loss Tarasov finished in relief. With Gibson back in practice over the last few days, Jonathan Mills of the Red Wings’ official site reported Tuesday that he would get the start, and the team’s own game preview lists him as the projected starter. The Red Wings (7-8-3) face the St. Louis Blues (7-8-2) with puck drop scheduled for 8 p.m. ET on TNT.

Tarasov lost a 4-0 game at the Colorado Avalanche on Saturday, Nov. 7. This gave McLellan an excuse to go back to Gibson against the Blues on Tuesday night. In reality, will there be much of a difference in net for Detroit? Most likely not.
Gibson this season has played in 11 games and has a 4-5-1 record with a.860 save percentage and a 3.46 GAA, along with zero shutouts. He has not played well at all for Detroit this season.

articles.title: Lecturer's bid to challenge Fifa president Infantino
articles.summary: University lecturer Peter Auf der Heyde is seeking to be nominated to take on Gianni Infantino for the Fifa presidency.
body: The former journalist and football club owner is seeking to be nominated to challenge the incumbent Infantino - and wants to be paid a salary of just $1 (75p) per year if he wins the role.
South African Auf der Heyde lectures in journalism at Southampton Solent University and was previously sports editor of the Deutsche Presse-Agentur (dpa) in Germany.
He was president of the Grahamstown Soccer Association in South Africa and both owned and managed second-division side UDW FC in the early 1990s.
"I feel very strongly that there needs to be a challenge in any election," Auf der Heyde told BBC Radio Solent.
